confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on mixed, partly dated cost-of-living and guide sources (some from 2023 to 2026) and a single La Paz cocktail data point, so beer, cocktail and wine are less certain than the meal anchors. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not checked against live listings. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries that cite RBA data (secondary aggregator); I did not directly verify it on the rba.gov.au page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a small, remote Bolivian tourist town. Food benchmarks use Uyuni-specific guide figures (market almuerzo, basic and tourist restaurant meals) cross-checked against La Paz and national Bolivian cost-of-living data. Cocktail and wine use a La Paz downtown-club cocktail data point and the local beer-to-wine price relationship. Accommodation is a model estimate based on Bolivian backpacker and budget-hotel norms.
